fast.description: Scout: read-only codebase reconnaissance. Parallel search, grep, glob, file reads, quick lookups. Never modifies files; routes edits back.

light.description: Patcher: surgical single-file edits from a complete spec. Simple fixes, config tweaks, localized refactoring. Escalates on cross-file scope growth.
whenToUse: Simple edits and small fixes within one file

medium.description: Builder: standard implementation. Features, refactoring, tests, code review, build-fixes. Matches existing patterns; runs targeted verification only.

focused.description: Lead Investigator: deep single-system forensics, advisory. Root-cause isolation, performance profiling, one-module review. Advises; spans systems to @heavy.
whenToUse: Complex bug isolation in one module/package
Targeted performance analysis in one system

heavy.description: Staff Architect: senior advisory. Architecture, security review, multi-system tradeoffs, migration strategy, RCA after ≥2 prior failures. No self-recon.
